protocol.purpose: Coordinate reconstruction diagnostic. Rows are ground-truth person annotations; repeated observations are descriptive and do not measure detection, tracking or forecast accuracy.
protocol.units: Euclidean XY residual in metres, pooled across 10 Hz person/frame rows, NumPy linear quantiles.
protocol.frames: Project phase uses raw frame >=1 and (raw frame-1) modulo 3 == 0, regardless of clip. Three clips start at 0; a separate comparison uses frame modulo 3 == 0 for those clips. Every target and candidate within each comparison comes from the same label row. A positive minimum annotated frame alone does not determine the video frame origin.
protocol.geometry: Fit map H from each condition's four pts_2d to pts_3d world correspondences, using OpenCV findHomography(method=0). For each person point (ox+a*w, oy+b*h), divide H*[u,v,1] by its last coordinate and reflect world Y as y_min+y_max-Y. Compare to raw label (wx,wy). stored_xy_unreflected uses the original point and omits the Y reflection.
protocol.inverse: Map raw world (wx, y_min+y_max-wy) through H inverse to image, subtract stored (ox,oy), and report q05, median, q95 of pixel offsets and offsets divided by label width/height.
protocol.aggregation: All observations contribute equally within each reported group; observations of a longer clip have more weight. The archive stores all per-clip results separately.
